import assert from 'node:assert'

evals.prompt: My merge of feature/cli left conflict markers in package.json and src/math.js. Can you sort it out?

fixture.description: package.json has a conflict where HEAD added a lint script and feature/cli added a start script; src/math.js has HEAD adding multiply and feature/cli adding subtract. src/cli.js uses subtract and the tests cover add, multiply and subtract. Both sides must survive and the tests must pass (which also proves package.json is valid JSON).

files.test/math.test.js:
import { test } from 'node:test'
import assert from 'node:assert'
import { add, multiply, subtract } from '../src/math.js'

test('math', () => {
  assert.equal(add(2, 3), 5)
  assert.equal(multiply(2, 3), 6)
  assert.equal(subtract(5, 3), 2)
})
